headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high‑flying performers and modest profit pressure.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from low single digits to over 50% YoY. Coforge led with 53.6% growth, while Infosys and HCLTech posted modest 1.5% and 11.5% gains respectively. Profit margins improved for most, but Wipro saw a 1.9% profit decline. AI‑related deals continued to boost top‑line growth across the sector.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and TCS crossing the 10% AI revenue threshold.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Operating margins rose for most companies, notably Coforge (16%) and TCS (24%).

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Revenue grew 13.6% YoY with strong AI‑led managed services wins.

laggards.why: Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but net profit fell 1.9% and headcount declined.
Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and profit guidance was cut.
